size.value: 45mm (height) × 35mm (width) [1.77in × 1.38in] — two identical facial photos required with all applications

background.value: Plain white background; must contrast with the applicant's clothing (e.g. no white shirt against the white background), lighting must be uniform with no shadows or reflections

validity.value: Photos shall not be more than six months old

clothing_restriction.value: There must be contrast between the image and background (e.g. no white shirt on a white background)

expression_restriction.value: Facial expression must be neutral, with mouth closed and eyes open, with no hair obscuring the eyes

glasses_policy.value: No prescription glasses, tinted shades, or sunglasses (full ban, no medical exception stated)

ears_visibility.value: The face shall look directly at the camera with both ears showing

face_visibility.value: Close-up of the applicant's head and top of the shoulders; the face shall take up 70-80 percent of the photo size in length

headwear_policy.value: No head coverings except for religious, cultural, or medical justification

clothing.en: There must be contrast between the photo image and the background (e.g. no white shirt against a white background).
clothing.ko: 사진 속 인물과 배경 사이에 대비가 있어야 한다(예: 흰색 배경에 흰색 상의 착용 금지).
clothing.ja: 写真の人物と背景の間にコントラスト(明暗差)が必要である(例:白い背景に白いシャツの着用不可)。

expression.en: Facial expression must be neutral, with mouth closed and eyes open, with no hair obscuring the eyes.
expression.ko: 무표정을 유지해야 하며, 입은 다물고 눈은 뜬 상태여야 하며, 머리카락이 눈을 가려서는 안 된다.
expression.ja: 無表情を保ち、口を閉じ目を開けた状態で、髪の毛が目を隠してはならない。

glasses.en: No prescription glasses, tinted shades, or sunglasses are permitted.
glasses.ko: 도수 안경, 색이 들어간 안경, 선글라스는 착용할 수 없다.
glasses.ja: 度付き眼鏡、色付き眼鏡、サングラスの着用は認められない。

ears.en: The face must look directly at the camera with both ears showing.
ears.ko: 얼굴은 카메라를 정면으로 응시해야 하며 양쪽 귀가 모두 보여야 한다.
ears.ja: 顔はカメラに正面を向け、両耳が見える状態でなければならない。

face_visibility.en: The photo must show a close-up of the head and top of the shoulders, with the face taking up 70-80 percent of the photo's length.
face_visibility.ko: 사진은 머리와 어깨 윗부분이 클로즈업되어야 하며, 얼굴이 사진 세로 길이의 70~80%를 차지해야 한다.
face_visibility.ja: 写真は頭部と肩の上部をクローズアップで写し、顔が写真の縦の長さの70~80%を占めなければならない。

headwear.en: No head coverings are permitted, except for religious, cultural, or medical justification.
headwear.ko: 종교적·문화적·의학적 사유를 제외하고는 머리 가리개(모자 등) 착용이 불가하다.
headwear.ja: 宗教上・文化上・医学上の理由を除き、頭にかぶり物(帽子など)を着用することはできない。

head_height.note: The official instructions do not state a head-height figure in cm/mm directly — they specify the face must occupy '70-80 percent of the photo size in length'. Applying that percentage to the stated 45mm photo height gives an arithmetic range of approximately 31.5-36mm (3.15-3.6cm). This is a derived calculation, not an explicit source figure, but it roughly overlaps the DB's stated 3.2-3.6cm. Disclosed here rather than placed in 'verified' since the source itself never states a cm figure.

file_spec.note: Photos are physically printed ('on high quality paper with high resolution') and glued/taped (not stapled) to the paper application form. The Passport Office also offers a 'Live Capture Photo' service for a $15 EC fee. No digital-upload pixel/KB specification is published, since this is not primarily a digital-upload system.
